title: `split` can be abused to create `locked` data with an arbitrary `amount`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Due to the lack of a check on the split amount inside `split`, a user can provide an arbitrary `_amount` to the function.
